items.text: Geedaha si tartiib tartiib ah u cagaaraan oo farxadaa ku keena. Wax kastaa si run ah u cusbonaanayaa.
items.q: Someone praises spring. Is it clear everything only seems to become fresh again?

items.text: – Ka dibna ka fikir waxa Baaba aan jacaylka ah uu soo marayo – guriga oo dhan joogay sannadahaan oo dhan.
items.q: Is it clear poor Baba has sat idle at home all these years?

items.text: Guriga Daawuud baan arkay. Suulku gacantayda ayuu ku jiray.
items.q: A small boy holds a thread to find his way. Is 'Suulku' right?

items.text: – Nin yahow, aad baad u caajis tahay. Goormaan waxan oo kale idhi?
items.q: Someone teases him for acting like a baby. Is 'caajis' the right word?

items.text: – Bilowga bisha Esfand waa nooc ka mid ah wakhtigee imtixaan?
items.q: Is it clear the speaker asks since when exams are held in early Esfand?

items.text: Mala-awaalkaygana, maalin kasta, marka Niluufar iyo Siinaa ay is arkaan, way is gacan qaadaan.
items.q: Is it clear Niloofar and Sina shake hands when they meet?

items.text: – Khamri-haan bay ka eg tahay weel.
items.q: Is it clear it looks more like a big clay jar than a vase?

items.text: Ka hor inta aan helo fursad aan ku idhaahdo waxa ahaa kaftan, feedhka Xamiid si toos ah ayuu u dhacay bartamaha sankayga.
items.q: Hamid punches him on the nose. Is 'feedhka' the right word for fist?
